summary: An Indo-Pacific reef surgeonfish with a blue body, black palette-shaped marking and yellow tail. It is an active marine aquarium fish that needs ample swimming space; its tail-base spines can injure handlers.

features: Blue sides with a black marking shaped like a painter's palette.
Yellow tail edged with black and a defensive spine at each side of its base.
Oval body is strongly flattened from side to side.

habitat.description: Coral reefs, with rock and coral shelter.
habitat.diet: Provide marine algae and seaweed along with a varied aquarium diet.
